text:
jordan: noticed a canary p95 decode regression after today's merge (PR #8421) — short-seq p95 up ~18%.

deploy-bot: merged PR #8421 into main by maya at 2026-03-18T08:12:03Z :rocket:

jordan: quick profile shows hotspots in kernel selection + enqueue wait. paste: 
```
38.9%  attention_kernel_v2
21.0%  kernel_selector::score_and_pick
13.4%  fused_op_scheduler
7.5%   dispatch::enqueue_wait (+2.8ms)
```

maya: PR adjusted the kernel smoothing heuristic (alpha) and added a short warmup window for the chooser, intended to reduce false-positive switches.

kevin: could that warmup be causing thrash on short sequences? we should gate it or flip for canary.

olivia: I can repro locally with short-seq traces. commands: 
1) export RUNTIME_KERNEL_SMOOTH_ALPHA=0.6
2) ./tools/run_decode_bench --model redwood-canary --seq-len 16 --qps 200
Result: p95 +22% vs alpha=0.3 baseline.

jordan: thanks. bench CI also flagged it — perf/serving/decode-p95 failed on main (p95 +19%).

bench-bot: CI job https://ci.example/serving/1423 failed: decode-p95 delta +19% on canary suite.

maya: old alpha was 0.3. we can override runtime for the canary pool while we triage.

kevin: plan: 1) flip override to 0.3 for canary routing 2) monitor 30m 3) decide revert/hotfix. anyone object?

jordan: +1. applying override now to pool canary-eu.

maya: override applied: RUNTIME_KERNEL_SMOOTH_ALPHA=0.3 for pool canary-eu.

jordan: metrics update — 14m after override p95 back within baseline ±2%. marking as mitigation. :white_check_mark:

kevin: good stopgap. we still need a bisect and a minimal patch that keeps warmup benefits without inducing flip-flop.

jordan: starting bisect job (bisect-7832) over the merge range to pinpoint the offending change. will report results here.

olivia: I captured a trace showing repeated kernel switches on short sequences when alpha=0.6 — the smoothing overshoots and oscillates. I'll open a microbenchmark PR to quantify selector scoring cost and attach a suggested fix (reduce alpha + add hysteresis).

maya: please prioritize the hotfix PR. if bisect blames another commit we'll adjust.

kevin: also add a canary-targeted test case to the perf matrix that exercises short-seq high-qps traffic so this pattern fails fast in CI.

jordan: agreed. I'll add the ablation and follow up with the bisect output + patch draft. handing off to maya/olivia for review once PR is up.

maya: thanks — monitoring and ready to review. :eyes:
